usedFor: Shopify holds the storefront's customers and products, and Cin7 Core keeps customer records through “Create Customer”.

bestTemplate.name: “Abandoned Checkout” in Shopify, then “Create Customer” in Cin7 Core
bestTemplate.why: Anyone who reached checkout with contact details is a prospect, so they are on file before the next order.

watchOut: “Update Customer” changes an existing customer, so use it, not “Create Customer”, for shoppers already on file.
